description: Security Builder GSE-C provides application developers with cryptographic tools to easily integrate encryption, digital signatures and other security mechanisms into C-based apps for FIPS 140-2 and Suite B security. Optimized with Elliptic Curve Cryptography, it can also be used with Certicom's PKI, IPSec, SSL and DRM modules.
